link.note: Named by Bradsby as Honora Dwyre, wife of Thomas Connole; son John F.'s obituary calls her 'Mary (Dwyer)'. Dates and father unverified.

summary: John's 4th-great-grandmother; Irish-born wife of Thomas Connole and mother of Mary Connole Heffernan.
bio: Honora Dwyre (Bradsby) or 'Mary (Dwyer)' (son John F. Connole's obituary) was born in Ireland about 1825 (FamilySearch; the tree shows 'Honora D Cannole 1828-Deceased'). She emigrated with Thomas Connole in 1848 and bore Mary (Elmira 1850), John F. (Elmira 1853) and Honora (Plymouth Twp c.1855). FamilySearch says she died at Elmira, NY, which would explain why Thomas remarried (speculative). The tree gives her father as Dennis Dwyer (1807-1875), not found online. Her Irish place of origin is unknown.
